responsibility: Declares the public interface and core data structures for RTL instruction recognition, constraints, and generated insn metadata. It defines operand-alternative parsing results, recog_data, insn_propagation helpers for substitution/simplification within insns, insn_data and operand descriptors produced from machine descriptions, target_recog caches for enabled/preferred alternatives, and the validation/change-group utilities used by RTL optimizers and reload.
same_name_distinction: Declares the recognizer-facing data structures and APIs—such as operand_alternative, recog_data, insn_propagation, insn_data, and target_recog—that gcc/recog.cc and generated recognizer code use; unlike gcc/recog.cc, it does not implement validation, splitting, or cache-reset behavior.
